text:
frank: Kicking off "Ignite Studio" live workshop (May 20)  primary goal: move demo attendees to active users by shipping persona-specific starter prompt kits + a small credit incentive. Want a clean experiment matrix, routing, copy hooks, and a budget-safe redemption flow. Quick sync?

sara: Love it. Suggest a 4-arm factorial across prompt personalization and credit size to tease out lift vs spend:
- Control: post-event docs + generic examples
- P1: persona starter kit only (Product/Data/Infra)
- P2: persona kit + 30 starter credits
- P3: persona kit + 75 starter credits + 48h in-app header nudge
Hypothesis: P2 will be most cost-effective; P3 will maximize raw first-success but with higher CPL.

leo: Tracking/events checklist: ignite_registered, ignite_attended, kit_downloaded, credits_awarded, credits_redeemed, first_success_call, active_7d, paid_30d. Include cohort_id, persona, preferred_model, fallback_model on every event.

leo: Landing -> inbound webhook sample (dev-friendly):
```json
{"event":"ignite_registered","email":"{{email}}","persona":"data","cohort_id":"ignite-may20-p2","preferred_model":"redwood-fast-1","fallback_model":"redwood-hosted-std","utm_source":"social"}
```

frank: UX tests: 1) show a temporary account header CTA "Use your starter credits" for 7 days vs no CTA (run on 30% of P2/P3) 2) add a one-click "Claim credits" checkbox on the landing vs deferred email grant. Keep 2x2 subset small to control budget.

ops-bot: Event created: ignite-studio-may20. Calendar invites sent. Reminders: 72h, 3h, 15m.

frank: Budget & cap rules: escrow credits into a campaign pool with hard cap $9,000. Auto-stop when cap hit; alert #finance at 70% and 90%. Finance, can you pre-approve the cap?

finance-bot: Noted. Automated alert will post to #finance at thresholds. Pre-approval pending manual review; will confirm by EOD.

leo: Also track model_used on credits_redeemed so we can compute per-arm cost by model variant. Add field model_used to redemption event.

sara: Copy hooks for socials + landing hero:
- "Ignite Studio: ship an LLM demo in one session. Starter kits + credits for attendees."
- Teaser microbenchmark line for the hero: "Cut query cost ~3x with persona prompts + caching" (use real numbers in slides).

frank: CTA variants to test: "Reserve spot", "Claim starter kit", "Get credits". For the landing, add microcopy under the credits checkbox: "Credits expire in 14 days. Redeem for API usage only."

leo: Dashboard plan: funnel tiles for reg->attend, attend->redeem, redeem->first_success, first_success->active_7d, active_7d->paid_30d. Cost calc tile: (credits$ + est infra)$ / activated_user. Cohort & persona filters.

sara: Deliverables & owners:
- Tracking doc + cohort ids: leo
- Prompt kits + example JS/Python snippets: sara
- Landing + email + social copy: frank
- Ops: webhook + cap enforcement + alerts: infra/ops (pinged)
Deadline: EOD Wed. Quick standup 10:30 tomorrow?

frank: Small micro-benchmark narrative for slide deck (leo can help):
1) Baseline friction: cold prompts -> low engagement
2) Intervention: persona kits + small credit + nudges
3) Expected signal: higher first_success rate and longer sessions/week; compute est tokens/week and est infra cost/user before vs after
4) Slide: sample table (avg tokens/session, sessions/week, est $/user) with placeholders to replace once we have pilot data.

leo: Dev snippet for the follow-up email link with utm+cohort:
```text
https://redwood.ai/ignite/start?utm_campaign=ignite-may20&utm_source=email&cohort_id={{cohort_id}}
```

frank: Ops & safety: add a per-user credit cap (e.g., max 100 credits per user) and require redemption endpoint to validate cohort_id and persona. Also ensure credits have TTL 14 days.

ops-bot: Task created: marketing/ignite-may20 assigned to frank, sara, leo. Due: 3 days.

sara: I'll post the persona starter kit drafts in #marketing-drafts later today and include minimal+recommended+full variants for each persona.

leo: I'll scaffold the dashboard and add cohort tags. Also adding a realtime watch that pings #finance when redemptions hit thresholds.

frank: Perfect. Thanks team :rocket: Let's keep copy tight and numbers concrete in the slides. Meeting 10:30 tomorrow.
